claim: PostHog people must be counted on person_id, not distinct_id (348 ids were 297 people), and plant_added only exists from 2026-06-08, so every earlier activation denominator is wrong.

body.measured: 2026-07-30 (DEC-252, DAL-242). PostHog project 166160, all-time, first query in 126 days. Aggregate server-side: a raw row fetch returned exactly 100 rows against a true count of 243 (the DAL-261 truncation pattern).

activation_correction_2026_07_30.supersedes: the activation_is_the_constraint block below, which is left in place but is WRONG
activation_correction_2026_07_30.defect_1: plant_added first appears 2026-06-08; installs are counted from 2026-04-25. 219 devices in DEC-252's denominator could not fire the event at all. plant_added, photo_added, location_added and onboarding_started ALL start 2026-06-08, which is the instrumentation ship date, not a behaviour change.
activation_correction_2026_07_30.defect_2: plant_count_snapshot (DEC-252's '181 of 186 never had a plant') only ever emitted on builds 13-40 and stopped ~2026-06-07. It is not in the current codebase. It describes April/May users of a superseded build, and is contradicted internally: 13 post-June people fired plant_added while 0 of the 7 post-June people with a snapshot show >0.
activation_correction_2026_07_30.defect_3: DEC-252's 'onboarding only asks gps and location' is stale. Benedict replaced it 2026-07-02 with a zero-dialog welcome screen, shipped in build 52; welcome_screen_shown fires on build 52 from 2026-07-23.
activation_correction_2026_07_30.corrected_july_cohort_public_builds: 9/33 = 27% added a plant; 19/48 = 40% reached the paywall
activation_correction_2026_07_30.contamination_check: July activators span builds 44-56 and US/UA/IN/AU storefronts. Internal builds 53-56 activate at 3/15, no better than public 9/33.
activation_correction_2026_07_30.real_open_question: RETENTION, not activation: 1 of 15 in the 8-14 day cohort returned on 2+ days.
activation_correction_2026_07_30.fix_shipped: 137442d. m_activation clips the all-time cohort to the day plant_added first appears, prints that date, and reports excluded devices as 'unknown not zero'. 7 render-text regression tests.

reporting_accuracy_2026_08_03.decision: DEC-259 / DAL-265, on Benedict's direct report that the numbers did not match what he could see in his own app
reporting_accuracy_2026_08_03.defect_1_identity: Every people-count was count(DISTINCT distinct_id). PostHog issues a new distinct_id per anonymous device and aliases it onto a person_id on sign-in, reinstall or restore. 348 ids across 297 actual people; one person carries 27 ids alone, another 14, another 11. Installs inflated 17%, so every conversion rate divided by them was understated, and each phantom id looks like a one-visit never-returner, which is how a returning buyer vanishes from the active count in the week they paid. Fixed: m_installs, m_active, m_activation, m_funnel, m_retention all count person_id, guarded by a test that reads the query source.
reporting_accuracy_2026_08_03.defect_2_plants: capturePlantAdded is called from exactly one place, lib/features/plants/screens/plant_form_screen.dart:596. Plants created by import or backup restore fire nothing, so plant_added counted plants typed in by hand, not plants owned. Ground truth was already in the payload (plant_count_after) and had never been read.
reporting_accuracy_2026_08_03.benedict_own_record: 113 plant_added events against a plant_count_after that reached 160
reporting_accuracy_2026_08_03.installs_since_2026_07_01_corrected: 50 people, not 60 distinct ids. DEC-256's 4.1% install-to-purchase becomes 4.0% on a denominator that means something.
reporting_accuracy_2026_08_03.app_side_fix_outstanding: NOT made by Dale. One event in lib/features/backup/services/import_service.dart and the restore path. Recommended: a separate plants_imported event carrying a count, rather than N capturePlantAdded calls, so hand-entry and import stay distinguishable.
reporting_accuracy_2026_08_03.consolidation: DAL-265 is now the single Treesmith reporting-accuracy ticket. DAL-269, DAL-271, DAL-264 and DAL-267 cancelled and folded into it. Backlog 39/40 -> 35/40.
reporting_accuracy_2026_08_03.still_open: A read-only RevenueCat API key (DAL-265, was DAL-267). Both RevenueCat keys in the app are String.fromEnvironment at build time, so nothing is readable from the mirror; do not re-search for one. Until it exists every dollar figure in the Monday email stays labelled directional.
